papers.title: Totally robotic low anterior resection versus conventional laparoscopic surgery for rectal cancer: a systematic review and meta-analysis
papers.authors: Kossenas K, Apostolou K, Lianos G, Lazaridis I, Kanavidis P, Linardoutsos D
papers.abstract: Totally robotic low anterior resection (TR-LAR) has not been consistently compared with conventional laparoscopic low anterior resection (L-LAR), as previous studies often combined hybrid and fully robotic techniques. This limits the ability to assess the true impact of a completely robotic approach. Therefore, a focused evaluation of TR-LAR versus L-LAR is warranted. A PRISMA-guided systematic review and meta-analysis of studies comparing totally robotic versus laparoscopic LAR was performed. Random-effects models were used to pool outcomes, with heterogeneity assessed by I² and evidence evaluated using ROBINS-I and GRADE. The review included five studies. Total robotic low anterior resection was associated with longer operative time (mean difference 43.2 min; p = 0.008) and a lower conversion to open surgery rate (-20% ; p = 0.02) than laparoscopic low anterior resection. There were no significant differences in estimated blood loss (13.3 mL lower; p = 0.65), overall complications (16% higher odds; p = 0.56), major complications (19% higher odds; p = 0.59), anastomotic leakage (1% lower odds; p = 0.99), postoperative ileus (197% higher odds; p = 0.21), length of hospital stay (1.1 days longer; p = 0.09), positive circumferential resection margin (32% lower odds; p = 0.47), lymph node yield (1.3 additional lymph nodes; p = 0.52), completeness of total mesorectal excision (67% higher odds; p = 0.42), or diverting ileostomy rate (62% lower odds; p = 0.47). Completely robotic LAR is linked to reduced conversion rates but extended operating duration in comparison to laparoscopic LAR, but other perioperative and oncological results seem similar. The evidence certainty is low to very low, necessitating additional high-quality research to elucidate the potential benefits of a totally robotic approach.

papers.abstract_zh: 全機器人低前位切除術（TR-LAR）過去未曾與傳統腹腔鏡低前位切除術（L-LAR）進行一致性比較，先前研究常將混合式與全機器人技術合併分析，限制了評估純機器人術式真實影響的能力。因此，有必要針對TR-LAR與L-LAR進行聚焦性評估。本研究依循PRISMA指引，進行比較全機器人與腹腔鏡LAR研究之系統性回顧與統合分析。採用隨機效應模型合併結果，以I²評估異質性，並使用ROBINS-I與GRADE評估證據等級。本回顧納入五篇研究。全機器人低前位切除術相較於腹腔鏡低前位切除術，手術時間較長（平均差43.2分鐘；p=0.008），轉開腹率較低（-20%；p=0.02）。在以下項目無顯著差異：估計失血量（低13.3 mL；p=0.65）、整體併發症（勝算高16%；p=0.56）、重大併發症（勝算高19%；p=0.59）、吻合口滲漏（勝算低1%；p=0.99）、術後腸阻塞（勝算高197%；p=0.21）、住院天數（長1.1天；p=0.09）、環周切緣陽性（勝算低32%；p=0.47）、淋巴結摘取數（多1.3個；p=0.52）、全直腸系膜切除完整性（勝算高67%；p=0.42）、以及暫時性造口比例（勝算低62%；p=0.47）。全機器人LAR相較腹腔鏡LAR，與較低轉開腹率及較長手術時間相關，但其他手術周邊與腫瘤學結果似乎相近。證據確定性為低至極低，需要更多高品質研究以闡明全機器人術式的潛在效益。

papers.title: Prevalence and risk factors of low anterior resection syndrome: Meta-analysis with Subgroup Analysis
papers.authors: Trabelsi M, Kammoun N, Nasri S, Ben Safta A, Samaali I, Nouira R
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: The prevalence of major LARS and its associated risk factors remains variably reported in the literature. This meta-analysis aimed to assess the pooled prevalence of major LARS and to identify its predictive factors.
METHODS: We conducted a meta-analysis in accordance with PRISMA 2020 and AMSTAR 2 guidelines to identify studies reporting the prevalence of major LARS or its associated risk factors. Subgroup analyses was used to explain heterogeneity.
RESULTS: A total of 21 studies comprising 3,730 patients were included. The pooled prevalence of major LARS was 36.8% (95% CI: 30.1%-44.0%), with a 95% prediction interval of 12.0%-71.2%, indicating substantial heterogeneity. Tumor location < 5 cm from the anal margin (p < 0.001) and neoadjuvant radiochemotherapy (p = 0.006) were significantly associated with increased major LARS risk. No significant associations were found with anastomotic leakage, surgical approach, or stoma closure timing.
CONCLUSION: Our meta-analysis showed a prevalence comparable to previously published data. Low tumor location and neoadjuvant radiochemotherapy were identified as two independent risk factors for major LARS. Prospective randomized trials are necessary to improve risk stratification for the development of major LARS.

papers.title_zh: 低前位切除症候群（LARS）之發生率與風險因子：統合分析暨次群組分析
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：文獻中對於重度LARS之發生率及其相關風險因子的報告結果不一致。本統合分析旨在評估重度LARS的合併發生率並找出其預測因子。方法：我們依據PRISMA 2020與AMSTAR 2指引進行統合分析，納入報告重度LARS發生率或其相關風險因子之研究。使用次群組分析以解釋異質性。結果：共納入21篇研究，3,730名病人。重度LARS的合併發生率為36.8%（95% CI: 30.1%-44.0%），95%預測區間為12.0%-71.2%，顯示存在顯著異質性。腫瘤位置距肛緣<5公分（p < 0.001）及新輔助放化療（p = 0.006）與重度LARS風險增加有顯著相關。吻合口洩漏、手術方式或造口關閉時機則未發現顯著關聯。結論：本統合分析顯示的發生率與先前發表數據相當。低位腫瘤與新輔助放化療為重度LARS的兩個獨立風險因子。仍需前瞻性隨機試驗以改善重度LARS的風險分層。

papers.title: Comparison of Diagnostic Performance of Node-RADS and ESGAR Criteria in Rectal Cancer Nodal Assessment at MRI
papers.authors: Li Q, Guo Y, Wu J, Chang T, Wang Z, Li X
papers.abstract: Background Suboptimal nodal assessment in rectal cancer hampers pre- and postoperative assessment for treatment planning. A recently proposed standardized nodal evaluation system, Node Reporting and Data System 1.0 (Node-RADS), lacks robust evidence of diagnostic utility. Purpose To validate and optimize Node-RADS against European Society of Gastrointestinal and Abdominal Radiology (ESGAR) criteria in MRI-based nodal assessment in patients with rectal cancer, with subsequent patient-level external validation. Materials and Methods This retrospective study included consecutive patients with rectal cancer who underwent MRI and radical surgery between January 2016 and July 2025. Node-level analyses were performed in patients from center 1, and external patient-level validation was performed in patients from centers 2 and 3. Two radiologists independently evaluated mesorectal nodes according to Node-RADS and ESGAR criteria. The optimal threshold of the Node-RADS score for diagnosing malignancy was determined using the Youden index. Diagnostic performance and interobserver agreement were assessed using area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC) and Cohen κ, respectively. Results This study included 780 patients (median age, 61 years [IQR, 53-68 years]; 477 men). Among 251 patients (1302 nodes) who underwent direct surgery, the optimal threshold of Node-RADS score was 3 or higher (Youden index, 0.65), enabling simplification to a modified model, the Simplified Nodal Assessment Process in Rectal Cancer (recSNAP). recSNAP outperformed the ESGAR criteria at both the node level (AUC, 0.83 vs 0.71; P < .001) and the patient level (AUC, 0.83 vs 0.71; P < .001). Similarly, among 284 patients (918 nodes) who received neoadjuvant chemoradiotherapy before surgery, Node-RADS with a threshold of 4 or higher outperformed the ESGAR criteria (AUC, 0.72 vs 0.66; P < .001). Interobserver agreement for Node-RADS at pre- and posttreatment MRI was substantial (Cohen κ, 0.76 and 0.64, respectively). Conclusion Node-RADS outperformed the ESGAR criteria for MRI-based rectal adenocarcinoma nodal assessment at both the node and patient levels and in external validation, and a simplified version of Node-RADS exhibited similar diagnostic performance. © RSNA, 2026 Supplemental material is available for this article.

papers.title_zh: 直腸癌淋巴結MRI評估：Node-RADS與ESGAR準則診斷效能之比較
papers.abstract_zh: 背景：直腸癌淋巴結評估效能不佳，妨礙術前與術後治療計畫之擬定。近期提出的標準化淋巴結評估系統Node-RADS 1.0，尚缺乏診斷效用之強力證據。目的：以ESGAR（歐洲胃腸腹部放射學會）準則為對照，驗證並優化Node-RADS於直腸癌MRI淋巴結評估之表現，並進行病患層級之外部驗證。方法：此回溯性研究納入2016年1月至2025年7月間接受MRI檢查與根治性手術之連續直腸癌患者。淋巴結層級分析於中心1之患者進行，外部病患層級驗證於中心2與中心3之患者進行。兩位放射科醫師獨立依Node-RADS與ESGAR準則評估腸繫膜淋巴結。以Youden指數決定Node-RADS評分診斷惡性之最佳閾值。診斷效能以ROC曲線下面積（AUC）評估，閱讀者間一致性以Cohen κ評估。結果：本研究共納入780名患者（中位年齡61歲，IQR 53-68歲；男性477人）。在251名直接接受手術之患者（1302個淋巴結）中，Node-RADS評分最佳閾值為3分以上（Youden指數0.65），可簡化為修正模型，即直腸癌簡化淋巴結評估流程（recSNAP）。recSNAP在淋巴結層級（AUC 0.83 vs 0.71；P<.001）與病患層級（AUC 0.83 vs 0.71；P<.001）均優於ESGAR準則。同樣地，在284名術前接受新輔助化放療之患者（918個淋巴結）中，閾值4分以上之Node-RADS表現優於ESGAR準則（AUC 0.72 vs 0.66；P<.001）。治療前與治療後MRI之Node-RADS閱讀者間一致性均為實質一致（Cohen κ分別為0.76與0.64）。結論：Node-RADS於淋巴結層級與病患層級以及外部驗證中，均優於ESGAR準則用於直腸腺癌MRI淋巴結評估，且簡化版之Node-RADS展現相似之診斷效能。

papers.title: Proteomic Differentiation of Colorectal Cancer From Normal Tissue via Ex Vivo E-Biopsy: A Novel Approach to Molecular Sampling for Diagnostic Precision
papers.authors: Saulis G, Vitkin E, Saule R, Wise J, Gulbinas A, Dambrauskas Ž
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is one of the most common malignancies worldwide. Early and accurate diagnosis remains a clinical priority, yet current biopsy techniques are invasive, spatially limited, and may not capture the molecular heterogeneity of tumors. We evaluated the feasibility and diagnostic potential of electroporation-based biopsy (e-biopsy) as a minimally invasive technique for proteomic sampling of colorectal cancer tissues. We conducted a multicenter, multinational study involving 19 patients undergoing surgical resection for CRC. Paired tumor and adjacent normal tissues were sampled ex vivo using e-biopsy. Proteins extracted from each sample were analyzed via LC-MS/MS. Bioinformatics pipelines, including differential expression, PCA, and pathway analysis, were used to identify CRC-specific signatures. E-biopsy consistently retrieved more proteins from tumor tissues than from adjacent healthy tissues (mean: 1300 vs. 800). Of the 3246 proteins identified, 54% were significantly upregulated in tumor tissues. Notably, proteins such as DLAT, LETM1, RBBP4, PPIB, and BCAP31 emerged as potential CRC biomarkers. Functional analyses revealed dysregulation in RNA processing, immune response, and metabolic pathways, consistent with known CRC biology. The integrated workflow, spanning tissue collection, electroporation, protein isolation, and mass spectrometry analysis across four institutions in two countries, was successfully executed, demonstrating the feasibility of multi-institutional implementation of the e-biopsy protocol while preserving tissue integrity throughout. E-biopsy enables rapid, reproducible, and minimally invasive molecular sampling of CRC tissue. This study demonstrates its potential to complement standard histopathology, aid in early diagnosis, and support molecularly guided treatment strategies in colorectal oncology.
papers.title_zh: 透過離體電穿孔活檢（E-Biopsy）進行大腸直腸癌與正常組織的蛋白質組學鑑別：一種用於診斷精準度的分子採樣新方法
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是全球最常見的惡性腫瘤之一。早期且準確的診斷仍是臨床首要任務，然而目前的活檢技術具侵入性、空間取樣有限，且可能無法捕捉腫瘤的分子異質性。我們評估了以電穿孔為基礎的活檢技術（e-biopsy）作為一種微創蛋白質組學採樣技術，用於大腸直腸癌組織的可行性與診斷潛力。我們進行了一項多中心、跨國研究，納入19名接受CRC手術切除的病人。使用e-biopsy對配對的腫瘤與鄰近正常組織進行離體採樣。從每個樣本中提取的蛋白質透過LC-MS/MS分析。使用生物資訊學管線，包括差異表現分析、主成分分析（PCA）與路徑分析，以鑑定CRC特異性訊號。E-biopsy從腫瘤組織中持續獲取比鄰近健康組織更多的蛋白質（平均：1300對800）。在鑑定出的3246個蛋白質中，54%在腫瘤組織中顯著上調。值得注意的是，DLAT、LETM1、RBBP4、PPIB和BCAP31等蛋白質浮現為潛在的CRC生物標記。功能分析顯示RNA處理、免疫反應與代謝路徑的失調，與已知CRC生物學一致。整合工作流程涵蓋組織收集、電穿孔、蛋白質分離與質譜分析，橫跨兩國四家機構成功執行，證明了e-biopsy協定在多機構實施的可行性，同時全程保持組織完整性。E-biopsy能實現快速、可重複且微創的CRC組織分子採樣。本研究證明其具有補充標準病理組織學、輔助早期診斷、並支援大腸直腸腫瘤學中分子導向治療策略的潛力。

papers.title: Short-Term Comparative Outcomes of Single-Port Robotic Surgery and Single-Incision Laparoscopic Surgery in Rectal Cancer: A Retrospective Multicentre Study
papers.journal_full: The international journal of medical robotics + computer assisted surgery : MRCAS
papers.authors: Ghazali K, Jeong Y, Kim I, Bae J, Choi B, Lee I
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Single-incision laparoscopic surgery (SILS) for rectal cancer has seen limited adoption due to its steep learning curve and technical demands. The advent of single-port robotic surgery (SPRS) may address these limitations by improving ergonomics and precision.
METHODS: This retrospective multicentre study compared the perioperative and pathological outcomes of SPRS and SILS in patients undergoing low anterior or intersphincteric resection for rectal cancer from 2014 to 2024 at two hospitals.
RESULTS: Among 110 patients (56 SPRS, 54 SILS), the SPRS group showed significantly shorter operative time (179.95 vs. 318.15 minutes, p < 0.001) and hospital stay (6.04 vs. 9.41 days, p = 0.030). SPRS was also associated with fewer postoperative complications (8.9% vs. 27.8%, p = 0.013). Stoma formation was less frequent in the SPRS group (28.6% vs. 50.0%, p = 0.031). SPRS yielded more harvested lymph nodes (22.70 vs. 16.83, p = 0.002).
CONCLUSION: SPRS offers clinical advantages over SILS and may be preferable in selected rectal cancer patients.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：單孔腹腔鏡手術（SILS）用於直腸癌因其學習曲線陡峭與技術要求高，臨床採用有限。單孔機械手臂手術（SPRS）的出現可能透過改善人體工學與精確度來解決此限制。方法：本回溯性多中心研究比較2014年至2024年間於兩家醫院接受低前位切除術或內括約肌切除術之直腸癌病人，SPRS與SILS之圍手術期及病理結果。結果：共110名病人（56名SPRS、54名SILS），SPRS組手術時間顯著較短（179.95 vs 318.15分鐘，p < 0.001）、住院天數較短（6.04 vs 9.41天，p = 0.030）。SPRS組術後併發症也較少（8.9% vs 27.8%，p = 0.013）。SPRS組造口形成率較低（28.6% vs 50.0%，p = 0.031）。SPRS組取得之淋巴結數目較多（22.70 vs 16.83，p = 0.002）。結論：SPRS相較於SILS具有臨床優勢，在特定直腸癌病人中可能為較優選擇。

papers.title: Comparison of Thrombocytopenia and Splenomegaly in Locally Advanced Rectal Cancer Patients Receiving Total Neoadjuvant Therapy With and Without Immunotherapy
papers.authors: Li S, Yan M, Ma Q, Sun Y, Zhang Z, Shen L
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Thrombocytopenia is a common toxicity of oxaliplatin-based chemotherapy and may be linked to hepatic sinusoidal obstruction and splenic enlargement. In the TORCH trial, adding PD-1 blockade to an oxaliplatin-containing total neoadjuvant therapy (TNT) regimen improved tumor response in patients with locally advanced rectal cancer (LARC), but thrombocytopenia appeared more frequent and more severe. Here, we evaluated whether adding PD-1 blockade to TNT increased thrombocytopenia risk and explored its association with hepatic injury and splenomegaly.
METHODS: We retrospectively reviewed 181 LARC patients treated at Fudan University Shanghai Cancer Center. The cohort included 44 patients who received long-course chemoradiotherapy (LCRT) followed by oxaliplatin-containing chemotherapy (Ox-TNT), 41 who received LCRT followed by irinotecan-based chemotherapy (Iri-TNT), and 96 who received short-course radiotherapy plus six cycles of CAPOX and toripalimab (iTNT). We collected serial blood test results and measured liver and spleen volumes before and after treatment. Thrombocytopenia was graded according to CTCAE v5.0.
RESULTS: Among 181 patients, thrombocytopenia occurred in 118 (65.2%), and splenomegaly in 69 (38.1%). Both events were most frequent in iTNT group, with incidences of 83.3% and 61.5%, respectively. Rates were lower in Ox-based TNT group (50.0% and 13.6%) and in Iri-based TNT group (39.0% and 9.8%), respectively. Platelet count showed an inverse correlation with both increased AST level (p < 0.001) and splenic volume (p < 0.001). In multivariate analysis, iTNT (p = 0.002), splenomegaly (p = 0.003), and older age (p = 0.004) were independently associated with G2-4 thrombocytopenia. Factors that independently predicted splenomegaly included iTNT (p < 0.001), direct bilirubin (p = 0.031), hepatomegaly (p = 0.032), and AST (p = 0.032). In the iTNT group, splenomegaly (p = 0.009) and older age (p = 0.033) remained associated with G2-4 thrombocytopenia. Lower CD8+CD28+ T cells and higher NK cells were associated with thrombocytopenia.
CONCLUSIONS: PD-1 blockade added to TNT was associated with more severe thrombocytopenia than conventional TNT in LARC patients, possibly through greater hepatic injury and splenomegaly.

papers.abstract_zh: 背景：血小板減少症是含奧沙利鉑化療常見的毒性，可能與肝竇阻塞及脾臟腫大有關。在TORCH試驗中，於含奧沙利鉑之全程新輔助治療（TNT）方案中加入PD-1阻斷劑可提升局部進展期直腸癌（LARC）患者之腫瘤反應，但血小板減少症似乎更常見且更嚴重。本研究評估在TNT中加入PD-1阻斷劑是否增加血小板減少症風險，並探討其與肝損傷及脾腫大之關聯。方法：我們回溯性審查181名於復旦大學附屬上海腫瘤中心接受治療之LARC患者，其中44人接受長程放化療（LCRT）後續奧沙利鉑為主化療（Ox-TNT）、41人接受LCRT後續依立替康為主化療（Iri-TNT）、96人接受短程放療加六個週期CAPOX併用特瑞普利單抗（iTNT）。我們收集連續血液檢驗結果，並測量治療前後之肝臟與脾臟體積。血小板減少症依CTCAE v5.0分級。結果：181名患者中，118人（65.2%）發生血小板減少症，69人（38.1%）發生脾腫大。兩者發生率皆以iTNT組最高，分別為83.3%與61.5%；Ox-based TNT組較低（50.0%與13.6%），Iri-based TNT組亦較低（39.0%與9.8%）。血小板計數與AST升高（p < 0.001）及脾臟體積（p < 0.001）皆呈負相關。多變量分析顯示iTNT（p = 0.002）、脾腫大（p = 0.003）及高齡（p = 0.004）與G2-4血小板減少症獨立相關。獨立預測脾腫大之因子包括iTNT（p < 0.001）、直接型膽紅素（p = 0.031）、肝腫大（p = 0.032）及AST（p = 0.032）。在iTNT組中，脾腫大（p = 0.009）與高齡（p = 0.033）仍與G2-4血小板減少症相關。較低的CD8+CD28+ T細胞與較高的NK細胞與血小板減少症相關。結論：在LARC患者中，於TNT中加入PD-1阻斷劑較傳統TNT導致更嚴重的血小板減少症，可能透過較大的肝損傷及脾腫大所致。

papers.authors: Tucker J, Turner B, Harrison A, Chamberlain R, Raju D, Murphy E
papers.abstract:
PURPOSE: Colorectal (bowel) cancer and its treatment can seriously affect a person's quality of life, including physical, social, work‑related, and emotional wellbeing. Young people with colorectal cancer experience worse psychological wellbeing, including marked emotional distress and prominent levels of anxiety. This disease is less common in people under 50, but cases of early‑onset colorectal cancer (EOCRC) are rising around the world. The object of this research was to derive a deeper understanding of the challenges and impact on quality of life faced by EOCRC compared to older patients following a colorectal cancer diagnosis.
METHOD: Recruitment of participants from a larger mixed method project of surviving EOCRC patients from 2013 to 2023 and a matched sample of colorectal cancer patients. 1 Participants invited to take part in an in‑depth semi-structured interview conducted by telephone or virtual meeting and audio taped, transcribed, and analysed using an interpretive phenomenological approach.
RESULTS: Twenty participants participated in interviews. Three themes (Headspace, physical impact and future) and eight corresponding sub themes encompassing poorer psychological quality of life, emotional distress and heightened anxiety faced by EOCRC. Barriers in current diagnostic services and treatment pathways more often reported by EOCRC.
CONCLUSION: Older and younger cancer patients highlight a shift from active to passive social roles with both groups reporting substantial reductions in overall quality of life and role functioning, but longer lasting impact for EOCRC, who are focused on family, fertility, career, and survival. A review of current diagnostic services and treatment pathways is required, tailoring care for all patients and importantly address the unique needs of EOCRC.

It is still less common in people under 50, but cases of early‑onset colorectal cancer are rising around the world.Younger adults are often building careers, forming long‑term relationships, and raising families, so cancer can disrupt their lives in separate ways than it does for older people. Research so far has not fully explored these differences, but this study shows that a colorectal cancer diagnosis and its treatment have a particularly strong negative impact on the QoL of younger patients.Young people with colorectal cancer tend to experience worse psychological wellbeing, including marked emotional distress and elevated levels of anxiety. These findings highlight the need for diagnostic services and treatment pathways to be better tailored to support all people with colorectal cancer, and to specifically address the unique needs of those under 50 years of age.
papers.title_zh: 早發性大腸直腸癌患者與年長患者生活品質差異之比較：一項質性研究
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：大腸直腸癌及其治療可嚴重影響患者的生活品質，包括生理、社會、工作及情緒層面的福祉。年輕大腸直腸癌患者的心理福祉較差，包括明顯的情緒困擾與顯著的焦慮程度。此疾病在50歲以下人群中較少見，但全球早發性大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）病例正在上升。本研究目的是深入了解EOCRC患者相較於年長患者，在大腸直腸癌診斷後所面臨的挑戰及對生活品質的影響。

方法：參與者招募自一項2013年至2023年的較大型混合方法研究，該研究對象為存活的EOCRC患者，並配對抽樣一般大腸直腸癌患者。邀請參與者接受深入半結構式訪談，透過電話或視訊會議進行，並錄音、轉錄，採用詮釋現象學方法進行分析。

結果：共20名參與者接受訪談。三個主題（心境空間、生理影響、未來）及八個對應子主題，涵蓋EOCRC患者所面臨較差的心理生活品質、情緒困擾及升高的焦慮。EOCRC患者更常回報目前診斷服務與治療路徑上的障礙。

結論：年長與年輕癌症患者皆呈現從主動轉為被動社會角色的轉變，兩組皆回報整體生活品質及角色功能顯著下降，但EOCRC患者受影響時間更長，其關注焦點在於家庭、生育、職業與存活。目前的診斷服務與治療路徑需要重新檢視，以因應所有患者的個別化照護需求，並特別重視EOCRC患者的獨特需求。

papers.title: Genetic Ancestry and Colorectal Cancer in the All of Us Dataset
papers.authors: Chatzipanagiotou O, Charalampous C, Cordle A, Elemosho A, Alizai Q, Mevawalla A
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Genetic ancestry may complement biological, behavioral, and clinical factors in understanding colorectal cancer (CRC) disparities; yet, ancestry-informed analyses in CRC remain limited.
OBJECTIVE: To characterize associations of genetic ancestry with CRC burden, age at diagnosis, and age-specific risk, and to develop a multiethnic CRC risk-prediction model.
DESIGN, SETTING, AND PARTICIPANTS: This retrospective cohort study used All of Us data from July 1986 to October 2023, with follow-up through last visit or death (median [IQR], 133.1 [57.1-186.5] months); analyses were conducted from February to June 2026. All of Us is a US research cohort with linked electronic health record (EHR) and short-read whole-genome sequencing (srWGS) data. All of Us Research Program participants with srWGS and linked EHR data were included, except those with hereditary polyposis or Lynch syndrome.
EXPOSURES: Genetically inferred ancestry categories and principal components.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Any CRC was the primary outcome. Associations were evaluated using Fisher exact tests, cumulative incidence functions with Gray tests, cause-specific and Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard models, and pooled multivariable logistic regression. Prediction models used penalized least absolute shrinkage and selection operator and extreme gradient boosting (XGBoost).
RESULTS: Among 316 624 participants (median [IQR] age, 56.3 [40.2-68.2] years; 172 327 [54.4%] of European ancestry; 191 705 female [61.2%]; 121 585 male [38.8%]), 2914 (0.9%) developed CRC. European ancestry was associated with higher odds of CRC vs all other ancestries combined (odds ratio, 1.50; 95% CI, 1.39-1.62). The median age at CRC diagnosis was older in European (63.4 [53.9-71.2] years) than in American admixed-Latino, African, East Asian, and Other ancestry groups. In cause-specific hazard models on the attained-age scale, American admixed-Latino (hazard ratio, 1.30; 95% CI, 1.14-1.47) and East Asian (hazard ratio, 1.43; 95% CI, 1.06-1.94) ancestry had higher age-specific CRC hazard than European ancestry, with consistent findings on the subdistribution scale accounting for competing death. The multiethnic XGBoost model performed best (receiver operating characteristic area under the curve, 0.898; 95% CI, 0.882-0.912; precision-recall area under the curve, 0.338; 95% CI, 0.296-0.379) and was well calibrated.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this cohort study, genetic ancestry was associated with meaningful differences in CRC burden and age-specific risk. These findings suggest that a multiethnic XGBoost model may complement CRC screening as a risk-enrichment tool.

papers.title_zh: 基因血統與大腸直腸癌之關聯：All of Us 資料集分析
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：基因血統可能有助於補充生物、行為與臨床因素以理解大腸直腸癌（CRC）的健康差距；然而目前針對CRC的血統知情分析仍相當有限。
目的：描述基因血統與CRC疾病負擔、診斷年齡及年齡特異性風險之關聯，並建立多族群CRC風險預測模型。
設計、場域與參與者：本回溯性世代研究使用All of Us資料，時間範圍自1986年7月至2023年10月，追蹤至最後就診或死亡（中位數[IQR]為133.1[57.1-186.5]個月）；分析於2026年2月至6月間進行。All of Us是美國的研究世代，具連結電子病歷（EHR）與短讀全基因體序列（srWGS）資料。納入具srWGS及連結EHR資料之All of Us研究計畫參與者，排除有遺傳性多發性息肉症或Lynch症候群者。
暴露：基因推斷之血統類別與主成分。
主要結果與測量：任何CRC為主要結果。以Fisher精確檢定、累積發生率函數配合Gray檢定、原因特異性與Fine-Gray次分布風險模型，以及匯總多變量邏輯回歸進行關聯性評估。預測模型採用懲罰式最小絕對收縮選擇算子（LASSO）與極限梯度提升（XGBoost）。
結果：在316,624名參與者中（中位數[IQR]年齡56.3[40.2-68.2]歲；172,327人[54.4%]為歐洲血統；191,705名女性[61.2%]；121,585名男性[38.8%]），2,914人（0.9%）罹患CRC。歐洲血統相較於所有其他血統合併，與較高的CRC勝算相關（勝算比1.50；95% CI 1.39-1.62）。歐洲血統CRC診斷年齡中位數（63.4[53.9-71.2]歲）高於美洲混血-拉丁裔、非洲、東亞及其他血統群組。在以達成年齡尺度建立的原因特異性風險模型中，美洲混血-拉丁裔血統（風險比1.30；95% CI 1.14-1.47）與東亞血統（風險比1.43；95% CI 1.06-1.94）的年齡特異性CRC風險高於歐洲血統，考量競爭死亡風險的次分布尺度分析結果亦一致。多族群XGBoost模型表現最佳（接受者操作特徵曲線下面積0.898；95% CI 0.882-0.912；精確率-召回率曲線下面積0.338；95% CI 0.296-0.379），且校準良好。
結論與相關性：在本世代研究中，基因血統與CRC疾病負擔及年齡特異性風險之間存在有意義的差異。這些發現顯示多族群XGBoost模型可能可作為CRC篩檢的風險分層輔助工具。

papers.title: National Cancer Institute-Supported Obesity and Cancer Research, 2015-2022
papers.authors: Dwyer L, Agurs-Collins T, Bailey C, Wolff-Hughes D, Czajkowski S, Reedy J
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: The National Cancer Institute's (NCI) interest in obesity and cancer reflects associations of obesity with cancer incidence, as well as potential impacts of obesity on cancer treatment, survivorship, recurrence, and survival. Given the growing prevalence of obesity and its implications for cancer burden, understanding the historical scope and direction of research in this area informs future needs.
OBJECTIVE: To describe trends in obesity and cancer research supported by the NCI over an 8-year period preceding the widespread uptake of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) receptor agonists and discuss scientific gaps and opportunities to guide research priorities in a rapidly evolving therapeutic landscape.
EVIDENCE REVIEW: Newly funded NCI grants in obesity from fiscal years (FYs) 2015 to 2022 were obtained from searching the publicly available National Institutes of Health (NIH) Reporter for the NIH obesity spending category. During 2023 to 2024, 2 coders independently categorized grants by areas of scientific focus and summarized funding trends over time.
FINDINGS: From FY 2015 to FY 2022, the newly funded obesity portfolio included 348 grants, and the number of NCI-supported grants focusing on obesity ranged from 38 to 59 new awards each year. An uptick in the number of new awards in FY 2022 was aligned with several funding opportunities relevant to obesity. Common research focus areas within this obesity and cancer portfolio included mechanistic (125 grants [49.4%]) and behavioral (96 grants [37.9%]) research, with breast cancer (54 of 162 grants [33.3%]) and colorectal cancer (30 of 162 grants [18.5%]) being the most heavily studied.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: In this descriptive study of the FYs 2015 to 2022 obesity and cancer grants portfolio, results showed that the NCI has consistently supported study of this critical research area, establishing a strong evidence base. Understanding the complex intersection of obesity and cancer requires sustained, multidisciplinary research. Multiple opportunities exist for advancing the science, including less studied areas, such as obesity's impact on cancer treatment and survivorship, obesity and cancer throughout the lifespan, obesity and cancer disparities, and the study of obesity as it relates to multiple cancer sites; additionally, as use of GLP-1 medications continues to expand, new opportunities may emerge to examine how intentional, pharmacologically induced weight loss may influence cancer risk, treatment response, and survivorship.

papers.abstract_zh: 重要性：美國國家癌症研究所（NCI）對肥胖與癌症的關注反映了肥胖與癌症發生率的關聯，以及肥胖對癌症治療、存活期照護、復發與生存的潛在影響。鑑於肥胖盛行率持續上升及其對癌症負擔的影響，了解此領域研究的歷史範疇與方向有助於指引未來需求。目的：描述在GLP-1受體促效劑廣泛使用之前8年期間，NCI支持的肥胖與癌症研究趨勢，並討論在快速演變的治療環境中，科學缺口與機會以指引研究優先方向。證據回顧：透過搜尋公開的美國國家衛生研究院（NIH）Reporter資料庫中肥胖支出類別，取得2015至2022財政年度（FY）新獲補助之NCI肥胖研究計畫。於2023至2024年間，兩位編碼員獨立將計畫依科學研究焦點分類，並總結資金趨勢隨時間之變化。研究發現：從FY2015至FY2022，新獲補助的肥胖研究組合共包含348項計畫，每年NCI支持的肥胖相關新獲補助計畫數量介於38至59項之間。FY2022新獲補助計畫數量增加，與數項與肥胖相關的資助機會時程相符。此肥胖與癌症研究組合中，常見的研究焦點領域包括機制研究（125項計畫〔49.4%〕）與行為研究（96項計畫〔37.9%〕），其中乳癌（54/162項計畫〔33.3%〕）與大腸直腸癌（30/162項計畫〔18.5%〕）為研究最多的癌症類型。結論與相關性：在此針對FY2015至2022肥胖與癌症研究補助組合的描述性研究中，結果顯示NCI持續支持此關鍵研究領域，建立了堅實的證據基礎。理解肥胖與癌症之間複雜的交互關係需要持續且多學科的研究。目前存在多項推進科學發展的機會，包括較少被研究的領域，例如肥胖對癌症治療與存活期照護的影響、肥胖與癌症在整個生命週期中的關係、肥胖與癌症的健康不平等，以及肥胖與多種癌症部位的關聯研究；此外，隨著GLP-1藥物使用持續擴大，未來可能出現新的研究機會，用以檢視刻意藥物誘導的體重減輕如何影響癌症風險、治療反應與存活期照護。

papers.title: Oral microbiome contribution in colorectal carcinogenesis: polymicrobial interactions and virulence determinants
papers.journal_full: Frontiers in cellular and infection microbiology
papers.authors: Glazunova E, Astakhova L, Kurnosov A, Doludin Y, Lyundup A, Kostin A
papers.abstract: The contribution of the microbiome to sporadic colorectal cancer (CRC) has traditionally been interpreted through the detection of individual tumor-enriched taxa or isolated virulence factors. However, accumulating evidence indicates that CRC-associated microorganisms often act as structured polymicrobial consortia rather than as independent agents. This review proposes an expanded ecological framework for understanding the role of oral taxa in colorectal carcinogenesis. Oral bacteria, including genera Fusobacterium, Parvimonas, Peptostreptococcus, Porphyromonas, Prevotella, Streptococcus, and related taxa, may translocate to the colorectal niche through enteral or hematogenous routes and establish tumor-associated communities that partially recapitulate the structural organization and succession patterns of oral biofilms. Within these communities, Fusobacterium nucleatum serves as the primary bridging organism, facilitating interspecies adhesion and spatial organization. Parvimonas micra, Porphyromonas gingivalis, and Candida albicans display potential bridging structural and functional properties, with their roles in cooperative pathogenicity and tumor progression supported by substantial experimental evidence. We integrate three complementary conceptual frameworks: oral microbial complexes (gut co-abundance groups), bridging organisms and the extended driver-passenger model of CRC. This synthesis supports a shift from taxonomy-centered interpretation toward a functional virulome-based view, in which the role of a taxon is defined by its ecological position, interaction network, and virulence determinants. Key oral virulence factors contribute to biofilm formation, epithelial adhesion and invasion, barrier disruption, immune evasion, inflammatory modulation, metabolic remodeling of the tumor microenvironment, and metastatic potential. Because the composition of translocated oral consortia changes gradually within the colorectal niche, successive consortium members and their associated virulence determinants may serve as indirect microbial signatures of CRC progression. Recognizing CRC-associated oral communities as structured, interactive ecosystems has important diagnostic and therapeutic implications. Simultaneous detection of pathobionts, their cooperative clusters, and functionally relevant virulence determinants may improve microbiome-based risk stratification. Moreover, targeted disruption of bridging functions, interspecies interactions, or virulence factor activity may offer a precision strategy to weaken carcinogenic consortia without broad, dysbiosis-promoting antimicrobial pressure.

papers.title_zh: 口腔微生物群在大腸直腸癌發生中的貢獻：多菌種交互作用與毒力決定因子
papers.abstract_zh: 微生物群對於偶發性大腸直腸癌（CRC）的貢獻，傳統上是透過偵測個別腫瘤富集菌屬或單一毒力因子來詮釋。然而，越來越多證據顯示，CRC相關微生物常以結構化的多菌種共生體（polymicrobial consortia）方式運作，而非獨立作用。本綜述提出一個擴展的生態學框架，以理解口腔菌屬在大腸直腸癌發生中的角色。口腔細菌，包括Fusobacterium、Parvimonas、Peptostreptococcus、Porphyromonas、Prevotella、Streptococcus及相關菌屬，可能經由腸道或血行途徑轉位至大腸直腸生態位，並建立腫瘤相關群落，部分重現口腔生物膜的結構組織與演替模式。在這些群落中，Fusobacterium nucleatum扮演主要的橋接生物角色，促進種間黏附與空間組織。Parvimonas micra、Porphyromonas gingivalis與Candida albicans展現潛在的橋接結構與功能特性，其在協同致病性與腫瘤進展中的角色有大量實驗證據支持。我們整合三個互補的概念框架：口腔微生物複合體（腸道共存豐度群組）、橋接生物，以及CRC的擴展驅動者-乘客模型。此綜合分析支持從以分類學為中心的詮釋，轉向以功能性毒力體（virulome）為基礎的觀點，其中菌屬的角色由其生態位置、交互作用網絡與毒力決定因子所定義。關鍵口腔毒力因子有助於生物膜形成、上皮黏附與侵入、屏障破壞、免疫逃避、發炎調節、腫瘤微環境的代謝重塑，以及轉移潛力。由於轉位口腔共生體的組成在大腸直腸生態位內漸進改變，連續的共生體成員及其相關毒力決定因子可能作為CRC進展的間接微生物訊號。將CRC相關口腔群落視為結構化、互動性生態系統，具有重要的診斷與治療意涵。同時偵測病原共生菌（pathobionts）、其協同群集，以及功能相關的毒力決定因子，可能改善以微生物群為基礎的風險分層。此外，針對性破壞橋接功能、種間交互作用或毒力因子活性，可能提供一種精準策略，在不施加廣泛、促進菌群失衡的抗微生物壓力下，弱化致癌共生體。

papers.title: Clonal Hematopoiesis in Colorectal Cancer: Mechanisms and Implications
papers.authors: Xia C, Lu Y, Gu J
papers.abstract: Clonal hematopoiesis (CH) arises from the expansion of hematopoietic stem and progenitor cells bearing somatic mutations, often in genes linked to epigenetic regulation and inflammation. Once considered a benign age-related phenomenon, CH has gained increasing attention for its potential to influence cancer biology beyond hematologic malignancies. Recent studies have uncovered an unexpectedly high prevalence of CH in patients with colorectal cancer (CRC), raising important questions about its origin, context-specific drivers, and pathological consequences. While cytotoxic therapies are known contributors, accumulating evidence suggests that the chronic inflammatory and metabolic alterations intrinsic to CRC may also shape hematopoietic clonality. In turn, CH-derived myeloid cells harboring mutations such as DNMT3A or TET2 can modulate the tumor microenvironment, promote inflammation, and impair antitumor immunity. In this review, we synthesize emerging findings on the bidirectional relationship between CH and CRC, highlighting the mechanistic underpinnings and potential implications for disease progression, therapeutic resistance, and immune modulation. Understanding this evolving interface may open new avenues for risk stratification and treatment personalization in CRC.

papers.title_zh: 大腸直腸癌中的克隆性血液生成：機制與意涵
papers.abstract_zh: 克隆性血液生成（clonal hematopoiesis, CH）源於帶有體細胞突變（常見於表觀遺傳調控與發炎相關基因）之造血幹細胞與前驅細胞的擴增。過去被視為良性的年齡相關現象，CH如今因其可能影響癌症生物學（不僅限於血液腫瘤）而日益受到關注。近期研究發現大腸直腸癌（CRC）患者中CH的盛行率意外偏高，引發對其起源、情境特異性驅動因子及病理後果的重要探討。雖然細胞毒性治療已知為其成因之一，但累積證據顯示CRC本身固有的慢性發炎與代謝改變，也可能塑造造血克隆性。反之，帶有DNMT3A或TET2等突變的CH衍生骨髓細胞，可調節腫瘤微環境、促進發炎並損害抗腫瘤免疫。本綜述整合CH與CRC雙向關係的新興發現，聚焦其機制基礎，以及對疾病進展、治療抗藥性與免疫調節的潛在意涵。理解此持續演化的交互介面，可能為CRC的風險分層與治療個人化開闢新途徑。

papers.title: Application of Systems Genetics to Investigate Molecular Pathology of Early-Onset Colorectal Cancer
papers.authors: Kim M, Carr S, Kulkarni V, Manchadi M
papers.abstract: Colorectal cancer (CRC) is the second most common cause of cancer-related deaths in the United States. The incidence of early-onset CRC (EOCRC) has been rising in the past few decades. Given the multifaceted nature of EOCRC, the genetic and environmental factors contributing to this malignancy have remained elusive. Systems genetics is a multi-omics tool that analyzes multiple genes as a collective network. Transcriptional correlation, protein-protein interaction network, functional annotation, and drug-gene interaction analyzes enable investigators to explore the functional roles of target genes and aid with discovery of novel diagnostic biomarkers and potential therapeutics. To clarify the objective of this work, this manuscript serves three purposes: a narrative review of recent systems genetics applications in EOCRC research, a step-by-step protocol for conducting these analyses, and a discussion of current advances in systems genetics to address limitations in generalizability and context dependence. Through this manuscript, we envision a future in which emerging oncology researchers adopt these tools into their investigations of EOCRC and other malignancies.
papers.title_zh: 應用系統遺傳學探討早發性大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）之分子病理機制
papers.abstract_zh: 大腸直腸癌（CRC）是美國癌症相關死亡的第二大原因。過去數十年間，早發性大腸直腸癌（EOCRC）的發生率持續上升。由於EOCRC具有多面向的致病特性，導致其相關遺傳與環境因子至今仍不明確。系統遺傳學是一種多體學（multi-omics）工具，能將多個基因視為一個整體網絡進行分析。轉錄相關性分析、蛋白質-蛋白質交互作用網絡、功能註解及藥物-基因交互作用分析，使研究者得以探索目標基因的功能角色，並協助發現新穎的診斷生物標記與潛在治療藥物。為釐清本文目的，本文包含三個部分：一、近期系統遺傳學應用於EOCRC研究之敘述性綜述；二、進行此類分析的逐步操作流程；三、討論系統遺傳學在可推廣性與情境依賴性限制方面之現況進展。透過本文，我們期望未來新興腫瘤研究者能將這些工具應用於EOCRC及其他惡性腫瘤之研究中。
